news.headline: Saints RB Travis Etienne Jr. activated off IR for game vs. Panthers
news.detail: The New Orleans Saints activated running back Travis Etienne Jr. off injured reserve prior to their game against the Carolina Panthers, the team announced Saturday.

news.headline: Questionable (Hamstring)
news.detail: Etienne thus is poised for his first game action since Week 3, when he strained his left hamstring. His status will be confirmed about 90 minutes before Sunday's 1:00 p.m. ET kickoff, but assuming he's active, he'll join a backfield currently occupied by Alvin Kamara and Audric Estime.
